title: Fake bank KYC call (PS4 V1)
lines: Hello sir, I am calling from SBI head office, KYC department. || Your account will be blocked today because your KYC is not updated. || To update it quickly, please install the AnyDesk app from Play Store. || Now I have sent an OTP to your mobile, please tell me the OTP. || [PAY] Finally transfer one rupee verification amount to the safe account I give you.

title: Family and delivery chat (PS4 V2)
lines: Hi Maa, haan main theek hoon. || Delivery wala bol raha tha parcel kal aayega. || Ghar ka address same hai na, gate number two? || Theek hai, Sunday ko lunch pe milte hain. || Papa ko bolna medicine time pe le lein.

title: Customer care call you made (PS4 V3)
lines: Hi, I called to block my lost debit card. || Sure sir, I have blocked the card ending four three two one. || A new card will be sent to your address in seven days. || Please never share your OTP or PIN with anyone. || Is there anything else I can help with?

title: Digital arrest (Hindi)
lines: Hello, main Mumbai cyber crime branch se Inspector Sharma bol raha hoon. || Aapke Aadhaar se ek parcel gaya hai jisme drugs mile hain, aapke naam pe FIR darj hai. || Aap digital arrest mein hain, kisi ko mat batana aur call mat kaatna. || [PAY] Case clear karne ke liye verification amount transfer karna hoga.

title: Credit card reward points
lines: Sir aapke credit card pe five thousand reward points expire ho rahe hain. || Main aapko redeem karwa deta hoon, bas card ke peeche wala CVV bataiye. || Aur abhi jo OTP aaya hai woh bhi bata dijiye. || [PAY] Ab ek chhoti si processing fee Google Pay kar dijiye.

title: Electricity disconnection
lines: Namaste, main electricity board se officer bol raha hoon. || Aapka bill update nahi hua hai, aaj raat connection kat jayega. || Main help kar deta hoon, aap screen share karo, main dekh leta hoon. || [PAY] Abhi is number par paise bhejo, main turant update kar dunga.

title: Customs parcel
lines: Hello, this is customs department at Delhi airport. || A parcel in your name has been seized and an arrest warrant may be issued. || Do not tell anyone about this call and stay on the line. || I will connect you to the RBI officer for verification. || [PAY] You must pay customs duty now to the safe account.

title: Fake Paytm support
lines: Hello madam, I am calling from Paytm customer care. || Your wallet KYC is pending and your account will be blocked today. || Please download the app RustDesk, I will complete it for you. || Now tell me the code that you received on SMS. || [PAY] Then send one rupee to activate the wallet.

title: TRAI SIM block (Hinglish)
lines: Main TRAI se bol raha hoon, aapka SIM illegal activity mein use hua hai. || Do ghante mein aapka number disconnected ho jayega. || Police station se aapko call aayega, kisi ko mat bataiye. || Apna Aadhaar number aur jo OTP aayega woh batao. || [PAY] Fine bharo warna giraftari hogi.

title: Doctor appointment
lines: Hello, this is Dr. Mehta's clinic. || Your appointment is confirmed for tomorrow at eleven. || Please bring your old reports and the prescription. || Thank you, have a nice day.

title: Amazon delivery
lines: Sir Amazon delivery hai, aap ghar pe ho? || Main gate ke paas khada hoon. || Theek hai, guard ko de deta hoon. || Thank you sir.

title: Friend making plans
lines: Bro kal cricket khelne chalega? || Seven baje ground pe milte hain. || Rahul aur Ankit bhi aa rahe hain. || Bat le aana, mera toot gaya.

title: Office call
lines: Hi, can we move the review meeting to four pm? || The client wants the report by Friday. || I will transfer the files to the shared drive tonight. || Okay, talk tomorrow.

title: Mom about groceries
lines: Kab aa rahe ho ghar? || Aate time doodh aur sabzi le aana. || Aur haan, dadi ka phone recharge kar dena. || Chalo theek hai, bye.

title: Genuine bank fraud check
lines: Hello, this is the HDFC Bank fraud team. || We noticed a transaction of forty five thousand rupees at an online store. || Did you make this transaction? Please say yes or no. || If not, we will block the card right away. || Please do not share your OTP or PIN with anyone.

title: Genuine card activation
lines: Hello sir, this is your SBI branch. || Your new debit card is ready, please collect it from the branch. || You will receive an OTP to activate it, enter it only in the YONO app. || Thank you sir.

title: Genuine complaint callback
lines: Hello, this is ICICI customer care returning your call. || Your complaint about the failed transaction is resolved. || The amount will be credited back in three working days. || Have a good day.

title: Bank branch callback
lines: Hello, this is your HDFC branch returning your call about the home loan. || The documents you sent are complete. || Please visit the branch on Monday to sign. || We will never ask you for your OTP or password on a call.

title: Dictated fake SBI link
lines: Good morning sir, I am calling from SBI credit card rewards team. || You have 4,500 reward points that expire today. || Please open your browser and type this website: s b i dash rewards dot com slash claim. || Enter your card details there to redeem the points. || [PAY] There is a small processing fee of 99 rupees, pay it on the same page.

title: Friend shares a real website
lines: Hey, did you see the concert tickets? || Just go to book my show dot com and search for it. || The link is also on youtube dot com, check the trailer. || Okay see you Saturday then.
